metadata.source: Vendor announcements, academic papers, press releases
metadata.note: Edit to add new hardware milestones. Push to trigger rebuild.

target_notes: ECDLP secp256k1 targets reflect the Mar 31 2026 Google Quantum AI paper (1,200-1,450 LQ) and the Oratomic neutral-atom paper (~10K physical qubits, space-efficient). These targets have fallen roughly 5 orders of magnitude in 20 years and are still dropping (ecdsa.fail challenge -8.4% from Google as of Jun 2026).

milestones.event: IBM Quantum Experience — 5 qubits, cloud access
Heron processor — focus on quality over quantity

milestones.note: First demonstration of error correction improving with scale
Novel topological approach, disputed by some researchers

milestones.event: H2 system — 56 qubits, record quantum volume
Helios — 98 physical qubits, beyond break-even QEC
milestones.note: 94 error-detected and 48 error-corrected logical qubits; logical error rates 10-100x below physical

milestones.event: 96 logical qubits via [[16,6,4]] code on neutral atoms (Nature)
milestones.note: First demonstration of >48 verified logical qubits; ~2:1 physical-to-logical ratio with error-corrected gates

milestones.event: Hanyuan-2 — first dual-core neutral atom system
milestones.note: Dual rubidium-85/87 cores, <7 kW power; benchmarks not yet independently verified

roadmap_targets.target: Kookaburra — first modular processor with quantum memory + logic
Cockatoo — entangle two Kookaburra modules via L-couplers
